answer: To resist Sybil swarms, the network clusters interaction graphs into a topological cut verification mechanism. Nodes cross-audit isolated subgraphs; any collusive cluster caught fabricating identities suffers stake slashing. Because traversing through fraudulent boundaries forces an exponential audit penalty, attacker cost scales superlinearly. Honest nodes cluster like a pearl within a meadow of trusted peers, while Sybil structures collapse into an insolvent spiral of slashed deposits.
